about: Source manifest for the directory's editorial guides. Each entry points to a Markdown body in directory/editorial/. The template renders the H1, byline, dateline, JSON-LD and CTA modules from this manifest. When rendering a body, drop its first two paragraphs after the H1 (the byline and the 'Reviewed' line), which exist so the Markdown reads correctly on GitHub. Under '## FAQ', each '###' heading is a question and the paragraphs until the next heading are its answer; emit them as FAQPage. Render '## Quotable facts' as a plain list with id="facts". Set status to "published" only after the page is live at its path; scripts/build-awesome-directory.mjs links published guides to the site and drafts to their Markdown source.
